description_en: Queries the Fudou (reward points) billing data generated by a specified enterprise within a specific time period
description_zh: 通过调用本接口可实现查询指定企业在特定时间段内产生的福豆账单数据
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen fu-point-bill-settlement-query --period-start 2021-10-01 --period-end 2021-10-02 --cooperator-id cooperator_alibtrip --bill-batch 20240101 --page-no 1 --page-size 100 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --scroll-id 1qwe --scroll-mod true --order-id 12345 --bill-record-time-start 2025-01-01 --bill-record-time-end 2025-01-02 --apply-id example-string --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: FuPointBillSettlementQuery
